{{Quote|He'll be all right. ''[&hellip;]'' He's not using much power right now, and your droid fitted him with some extra power packs on the way in.''"<br />"''Wait a second. ''[&hellip;]'' My droid, Slips? I thought you said you came by X-wing.|Jedi Master Luke Skywalker and former Emperor's Hand Mara Jade|<ref name="VOTF" />}}
'''Slips''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] used by former [[Emperor's Hand]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] during the [[Caamas Document Crisis]].<ref name="VOTF" /> In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]],<ref name="Date">The events of ''[[Vision of the Future]]'' take place in [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''.</ref> in a [[Mission to Nirauan|mission]] to the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nirauan/Legends|Nirauan]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] brought Jade's [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the [[Personal Luxury Yacht 3000/Legends|Personal Luxury Yacht 3000]] ''[[Jade's Fire]]'', along with Slips, to the planet in an attempt to rescue Jade, who had traveled to Nirauan while searching for the [[Hand of Thrawn]] [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]].<ref name="VOTF" />

After finding Jade and arriving with her at the Hand of Thrawn, the former Emperor's Hand expressed that she hoped that Skywalker's [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]{{'s}} battery did not run out, prompting the droid's owner to confess that he had taken the ''Jade's Fire'' to Nirauan and that Slips had equipped R2 with extra power packs.<ref name="VOTF" />

==Behind the scenes==
Slips was first mentioned in the [[1998]] novel ''[[Vision of the Future]]'', the final volume in [[Timothy Zahn]]'s ''[[Star Wars: The Hand of Thrawn Duology]]''.<ref name="VOTF" />
